dag_infos.description: New Taipei City divorce rates by sex and age from MOI RIS ODRP118. The denominator is currently married population, not total population; source rates are retained without summation or population scaling.

data_infos.name_cn: 新北市有偶人口離婚率（按性別及年齡）
data_infos.source_type: 內政部戶政司 RIS OpenData API (ODRP118)
data_infos.dataset_description: 各縣市有偶人口離婚率按性別與年齡資料。本DAG只取新北市（來源代碼65000000，契約統一65000），保留總計、未滿20歲、20至24歲至65歲以上各率。民國113目前缺男性列。分母是同年同縣市同性別同年齡的有偶人口，單位為每千名有偶人口。
data_infos.etl_description: Probe ROC years with RIS responseCode; OD-0102-S is HTTP 200 no data. Normalize Chinese ROC 113 and English ROC 114 columns by semantic aliases, filter county 新北市 and source code 65000000, allow only the measured ROC 113 missing male row through KNOWN_INCOMPLETE_PERIODS, do not impute it, and fail on any different missing row. Parse the source age bands to nullable integer bounds, reconcile every rate cell one-to-one, and run a three-times-median annual scale guard without summing rates. Because the source supplies rates rather than numerators and denominators, no 18-35 composite rate is written; query-time denominator-weighted calculation is required.
